resources.string: Point your camera at a surface, place two points, and get the distance between them in seconds.
Move your phone slowly until the crosshair turns teal.
Aim at the start and tap +, then aim at the end and tap + again.
Switch between metres, centimetres, and feet and inches.
Results are estimates. Accuracy depends on lighting, surface texture and how steadily you move.
This device doesn\'t support the AR technology MeasureAR needs.
Illustration: two points placed on a floor with a distance label between them.
You\'re moving too fast. Slow down.
It\'s too dark. Move to a brighter spot.
Point at a surface with more texture or detail.
The camera is being used by another app.
Tracking lost. Move slowly back to where you started.
Move your phone slowly to detect a surface.
Surface found. Aim at your start point and tap +.
Aim at a surface for your second point.
Aim at your end point and tap +.
Measurement complete. Tap + to measure something else.
Estimate. Accuracy varies with light and surface.
MeasureAR uses your camera to see and measure your surroundings. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
This phone doesn\'t support the AR technology MeasureAR needs.
MeasureAR needs Google Play Services for AR. Please allow the installation and try again.
Please update Google Play Services for AR from the Play Store, then try again.
This version of MeasureAR is too old for the installed AR services. Please update the app.
Something went wrong while starting the camera and AR. Please try again.
Another app may be using the camera. Close it and try again.
